result.description: A fictional compact audio-visual control console for live projection artists and installation spaces. It combines a programmable light matrix, tactile macro keys, and USB-C network sync for coordinating stage cues, ambient effects, and custom scenes. Designed as a creative studio instrument rather than a storage or graphics device, it targets performance workflows in galleries and experimental venues.
result.title: Nebula Forge Lattice Console
result.title_description: Compact creative control console for live visual performance and scene automation
